                                 SOAH DOCKET NO. 473-26-16349
                                    PUC DOCKET NO. 59475
JOINT APPLICATION OF ONCOR                              §
ELECTRIC DELIVERY COMPANY LLC                           §
AND LCRA TSC TO AMEND THEIR                             §
CERTIFICATES OF CONVENIENCE AND                         §                    BEFORE THE
NECESSITY FOR THE BELL COUNTY                           §
EAST SWITCH TO BIG HILL                                 §
SUBSTATION 765-KV TRANSMISSION                          §         PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION
LINE PROJECT IN BELL, BURNET,                           §
CONCHO, CORYELL, LAMPASAS,                              §                       OF TEXAS
LLANO, MASON, MCCULLOCH,                                §
MENARD, MILAM, MILLS, SAN SABA,                         §
SCHLEICHER, TOM GREEN, AND                              §
WILLIAMSON COUNTIES, TEXAS                              §
                     CROSS-STIPULATION OF N12/P1 INTERVENORS 1 AND
                           LINK R1 OPPOSITION LANDOWNERS 2

        COME NOW, N12/P1 Intervenors (Party No. 635) and Link R1 Opposition Landowners

(Party No. 664) file this Cross-Stipulation and hereby stipulate and agree as follows:

                I.       STIPULATIONS OF THE LINK R1 OPPOSITION LANDOWNERS

1.      In their respective written testimonies, the Link R1 Opposition Landowners have each

expressed concerns regarding the adverse effects a transmission line routed along Link R1 would

have upon their properties. Those concerns encompass impacts to ranching operations, water

resources, hunting and recreational uses, land value, and the natural character and aesthetic of their

respective properties.

2.      The Link R1 Opposition Landowners acknowledge that the N12/P1 Intervenors have

expressed the same or similar concerns over the effect that a transmission line route using Links

N12, O1, and/or P1 would have on their respective properties.



1
  N12/P1 Intervenors include KLM Griffin Ranch, L.P.; Quillen Family Partnership, Ltd.; William Quillen; James
Blake Quillen; Carolyn Quillen; and Pfluger Family Limited Partnership
2
  Link R1 Opposition Landowners include Dennis Grafa, Gary and Katherine Johnson, Tana Autrey, 9-Campbell
Ranch, L.P., Sharon Holman as Trustee of the Charles Ray Pfluger Shelter Trust, Melissa O’Harrow and James
Hamilton O’Harrow Family Trust, and Chase B. Akin

PUC DOCKET NO. 59475; SOAH ORDER NO. 473-26-16349; CROSS-STIPULATION
PAGE 1 OF 6
 3.      The Link R1 Opposition Landowners hereby acknowledge and stipulate that wherever the

proposed transmission line is ultimately constructed, the ranching operations, water resources,

hunting and recreation uses, land value, and the natural use of that real property will be negatively

affected by the transmission line.

4.      The Link R1 Opposition Landowners further agree to waive cross-examination of Carolyn

Quillen, William Reid Pfluger, and John A. “Matt” Matthews, Jr. conditioned upon the following

being admitted into the record: (a) Link R1 Opposition Landowners’ First RFI requests (and all

attachments) and responses from N12/P1 Intervenors; (b) Link R1 Opposition Landowners’

Second RFI requests to Pfluger Family Limited Partnership (as set forth in Section IV below) and

responses thereto; and (c) the stipulations set forth herein.

5.      The Link R1 Opposition Landowners agree that KLM Griffin Ranch L.P.’s Response to

Link R1 Opposition Landowners’ First Set of Requests for Information, Question R1 OPP 1-2

(Interchange No. 5824), unredacted and in its entirety, shall be offered into the record, including

the maps submitted by the N12/P1 Intervenors in response depicting windmill and water well

locations on the KLM Griffin Ranch L.P. property in relation to Links O1 and P1.

                       II.     STIPULATIONS OF THE N12/P1 INTERVENORS

6.      Carolyn Quillen, as a member of the N12/P1 Intervenor group, individually acknowledges

and stipulates that her nephew, Lee Upton, operates the property identified in her Direct Testimony

as the Cave Springs Ranch.

7.      N12/P1 Intervenors agree and stipulate that they have no objections to (1) Link R1

Opposition Landowner’s Exhibits 12, 13, and 14 as uploaded to Egnyte (2) or Link R1 Opposition

Landowner’s Exhibit 15 (not yet uploaded to Egnyte), which shall be the map attached hereto as

Exhibit “A” in response to R1 OPP 2-2 below.



PUC DOCKET NO. 59475; SOAH ORDER NO. 473-26-16349; CROSS-STIPULATION
PAGE 2 OF 6
                                      III.    JOINT STIPULATIONS

8.       The parties jointly stipulate and agree that the stipulations set forth herein are made for

purposes of this proceeding only and shall not be construed as admissions or waivers for any other

purpose.

 IV.       SECOND REQUEST FOR INFORMATION FROM LINK R1 OPPOSITION LANDOWNERS TO
                            PFLUGER FAMILY LIMITED PARTNERSHIP
9.       The following constitutes the Second Request for Information (“Second RFI”) propounded

by the Link R1 Opposition Landowners to Pfluger Family Limited Partnership (“Pfluger”), a

member of N12/P1 Intervenors, and N12/P1 Intervenors Responses to those requests. The parties

agree that this Second RFI, together with the responses thereto, shall be admitted into the record

in this Docket.

Definitions

10.      For purposes of this Second RFI, the following terms shall have the meanings set forth

below:

11.      “Tom Green County Property” shall mean the tracts and land identified by William Reid

Pfluger in his Direct Testimony, filed on the Public Utility Commission Interchange as Item No.

3881.

12.      “Direct Testimony” shall mean the Direct Testimony filed by William Reid Pfluger on

behalf of the Pfluger Family Limited Partnership filed on the Interchange as Item No. 3881.

13.      The parties further refer to and incorporate by reference the Link R1 Opposition

Landowners’ First Request for Information to Pfluger Family Limited Partnership and its

attachments (Interchange No. 5265), and Pfluger Family Limited Partnership’s response to the

First Request (Interchange No. 5826).




PUC DOCKET NO. 59475; SOAH ORDER NO. 473-26-16349; CROSS-STIPULATION
PAGE 3 OF 6
 Requests

14.     R1 OPP. 2-1. In response to Link R1 Opposition Landowners’ RFI 1-6 and RFI 1-7,

Pfluger denied that the Solar Energy Lease Agreement with Greenalia Solar Power Pioneer Field,

LLC and the Wind Energy Lease Agreement with Greenalia Wind Power Pioneer Field, LLC

(collectively, the “Greenalia Leases”) pertain to the Tom Green County Property.

        Admit or Deny: The Greenalia Leases encumber, pertain to, or relate to real property

located in the same general area as the Tom Green County Property, and this property is separated

from the Tom Green County Property by adjacent property referenced in Carolyn Quillen’s Direct

Testimony, and this real property is adjacent to real property owned by KLM Griffin Ranch, L.P.

        Response: Admit.

15.     R1 OPP. 2-2. Please provide a map or screenshot identifying the real property encumbered

by the Greenalia Leases that shows its location in relation to the Tom Green County Property,

including the approximate distance between the two properties.

        Response: The responsive document is attached hereto as Exhibit “A”.

        WHEREFORE, PREMISES CONSIDERED, the parties hereto, having agreed to the

foregoing stipulations, respectfully request that the Administrative Law Judges admit Link R1

Opposition Landowners’ Exhibits 12, 13, and 14, this Cross-Stipulation, together with the Second

Request for Information and responses thereto referenced herein, into the evidentiary record of

this proceeding, and that the same be given full force and effect. Link R1 Opposition Landowners

and N12/P1 Intervenors further request that they be granted such other and further relief to which

they may be justly entitled.




PUC DOCKET NO. 59475; SOAH ORDER NO. 473-26-16349; CROSS-STIPULATION
